background: Credit Agricole S.A. is the listed central body of the Credit Agricole group, France's largest banking group by retail deposits, owned by the regional cooperative banks and housing the group's insurance, asset management, consumer finance and corporate and investment banking.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, A+ on average, one on a negative outlook and two on a stable outlook; one of the three moved to negative outlook on 3 Nov 2026. Capital is the strength, with CET1 of 17.2% above the EU and Nordic peer median and leverage of 5.5% just above it. Liquidity is the weaker side, with LCR of 136% in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 120% below the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026, so the negative outlook is the thing that has changed.
